'''Nardakka''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Nardakka worked as a courier for the criminal [[Vex (Human)|Vex]] and during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], was among a group of couriers that were sent by Vex to collect an illicit cargo in the jungles of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. However, they were ambushed by thugs working for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Riboga]]. Nardakka was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the thugs detonated a [[thermal mine]].
